about.whoWeAreTitle: Founded in 2017 to Serve the Vulnerable
about.whoWeAreDesc1: World Changers Mental Health Care Organisation was founded in 2017 with a singular purpose: to serve the most vulnerable members of our communities. Born out of a deep understanding that mental health is inseparable from overall well-being, we set out to bridge the gap between those in need and the care they deserve.
about.whoWeAreDesc2: Today, we operate across multiple regions, delivering compassionate care, humanitarian aid, and life-changing programs that empower individuals to rebuild their lives with dignity and hope.
about.whatWeDoDesc: Addressing the intersection of poverty, mental health, and community empowerment.
about.mentalHealthServicesDesc: We provide counselling, therapy, trauma recovery, and crisis intervention services to individuals and families, recognising the critical link between poverty and mental health.
about.humanitarianAidDesc: We deliver essential humanitarian aid to underserved communities, offering food, shelter support, and resources to those affected by poverty and displacement.
about.communityOutreachDesc: Our outreach programs connect with grassroots communities, providing education, skills development, and empowerment to break cycles of poverty and stigma.
about.humanRightsAdvocacyDesc: We advocate for the rights of marginalised individuals, ensuring equitable access to healthcare, education, and social justice.
about.substanceAbusePreventionDesc: Our prevention programs address substance abuse through education, early intervention, and rehabilitation support within vulnerable communities.
about.skillsDevelopmentDesc: We equip individuals with vocational and life skills, enabling self-sufficiency and economic empowerment for sustainable change.
about.missionDesc: To deliver innovative, high-quality mental health services and humanitarian aid, driven by compassion, collaboration, and advocacy. We break stigma, provide accessible education and support, and build resilient communities through mental health advocacy, outreach, and storytelling, ensuring no one is left behind.
about.visionTitle: A World Free of Mental Health Stigma
about.visionDesc: To be a world-class humanitarian and mental health organisation that transforms communities through counselling, therapy, skills development, crisis management, and sustainable care, making mental health care accessible, sustainable, and impactful, while fostering resilience and social empowerment by 2035.
about.compassionDesc: Every person deserves kindness, empathy, and understanding in their journey toward mental wellness.
about.excellenceDesc: We uphold the highest clinical standards and continually evolve our methods with the latest research.
about.integrityValDesc: Transparency, honesty, and ethical practice guide every decision we make as an organisation.
about.inclusivityValDesc: Mental health care should be accessible to all, regardless of background, culture, or circumstance.

faq.heroSubtitle: Answers to the questions we hear most
faq.q1: What is World Changers Mental Health Care Organisation?
faq.a1: World Changers Mental Health Care Organisation is a registered South African non-profit (NPO 238-677) and Public Benefit Organisation (PBO 930084594) based in Johannesburg. We make dignified, professional mental health care reachable across South Africa through scheduled virtual counselling and community wellbeing programmes.
faq.q2: What mental health services do you offer?
faq.a2: We provide individual counselling, couples and family therapy, child and adolescent support, trauma and grief counselling, and psychoeducation and wellness workshops for schools, organisations and communities. Care is warm, confidential and tailored to your needs.
faq.q3: How do I book a session or access support?
faq.a3: Go to our Mental Health page, choose your preferred professional, and complete the short booking request. Our team confirms your virtual appointment by email or phone. You can also call us — every session is by appointment.
faq.q4: Are your counselling sessions really free?
faq.a4: Yes. As a donation-funded Public Benefit Organisation, we offer free virtual counselling so that cost is never a barrier to getting help. You do not need medical aid or insurance to book with us.
faq.q5: Are sessions virtual or in person?
faq.a5: Sessions are conducted virtually over a secure video link, by appointment, so you can access support from anywhere in South Africa. Each session runs about 60 minutes.
faq.a6: Our services are open to children, adolescents and adults, as well as families, couples, schools, organisations and community groups — regardless of background. Everyone is welcome.
faq.q7: What happens in the first session?
faq.a7: Your first session is a relaxed conversation about what brought you to counselling, your goals, and how we can help. Your counsellor will explain confidentiality and answer any questions. It is also a chance to see whether you feel comfortable working together.
faq.a8: Yes. Everything you share is treated as confidential and handled in line with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) and professional ethical standards. Confidentiality is only limited where there is a risk of harm to you or others, suspected abuse or neglect, or where records are required by law.
faq.q9: How do I know if I should reach out for counselling?
faq.a9: You do not need to be in crisis to seek support. If you are experiencing persistent sadness, anxiety, stress, grief, relationship difficulties, trauma, or you simply feel overwhelmed or unable to cope, counselling can help.
faq.q10: What should I do if I am in a crisis right now?
faq.a10: World Changers provides scheduled, appointment-based care — we are not a 24-hour emergency service. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 112 (national emergency line) or 10177 (ambulance), or go to your nearest hospital emergency department. You can also reach the free 24/7 SADAG Suicide Crisis Helpline on 0800 567 567.
faq.q11: How can I volunteer with World Changers?
faq.a11: We would love your help. Visit our Become a Volunteer page and complete the registration form — our team reviews every application and will be in touch. There are both in-person and remote ways to get involved.
faq.q12: How can my school, company or organisation partner with you?
faq.a12: We welcome partnerships with schools, businesses, NGOs and funders — from wellness workshops to community outreach and sponsorship. Visit our Partnerships page or contact us to explore working together.
faq.q13: How can I donate, and is my donation tax-deductible?
faq.a13: You can donate securely by card via Paystack or by EFT — one-time or monthly. As a registered PBO, we issue a Section 18A tax-deductible receipt (within 48 hours), which you can use for SARS tax purposes. Every contribution helps keep our counselling free.
faq.q14: How can I contact World Changers?
faq.a14: Email us at info@worldchangersmh.org or call our administrative office during working hours (Monday to Friday). As a virtual-first organisation, we support people across South Africa — the quickest way to start is the booking form on our Mental Health page.
